**** **ORLANDO, FL /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / **October 22, 2026** /** Laser Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:LASE), an emerging directed energy and laser technology platform developing applications for defense, semiconductor, pharmaceutical and industrial markets (the “Company”), today announced that it will release financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 before market open on Thursday, November 12, 2026.


Management will host an investor conference call at 8:00 a.m. Eastern time on Thursday, November 12, 2026 to discuss the Company’s third quarter 2026 financial results, provide a corporate update, and conclude with Q&A from telephone participants. To participate, please use the following information:


**Third Quarter 2026 Earnings Conference Call**
Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026
Time: 8:00 a.m. Eastern time
U.S. Dial-in: 1-877-407-3982
International Dial-in: 1-201-493-6780
Conference ID: 13763522
Webcast:[LASE Q3 2026 Earnings Conference Call](https://pr.report/skp1)


Please join at least five minutes before the start of the call to ensure timely participation.


Dmitriy Nikitin, Executive Chairman of Laser Photonics, said: “One of my first priorities as I step into this role is establishing dialogue and transparency with our shareholders, and reinstating our quarterly earnings calls is an important part of that commitment. I look forward to speaking directly with shareholders about our business – where it stands today and where it is going.”


A telephone playback of the call will be available through Thursday, November 19, 2026. To listen, please call 1-844-512-2921 within the United States and Canada or 1-412-317-6671 when calling internationally, using replay pin number 13763522. A webcast replay will also be available using the webcast link above.


**About Laser Photonics Corporation**


Laser Photonics Corporation (NASDAQ:LASE) is an emerging defense and directed energy technology platform focused on developing laser applications to address defense and security needs and on applying its core industrial laser products to help modernize the domestic manufacturing infrastructure required to support U.S. national security.


The Company develops laser platforms for four principal markets: defense, semiconductor, pharmaceutical and industrial. Through internal development, strategic acquisitions and partnerships, LASE intends to expand its technology portfolio, strengthen its advanced manufacturing capabilities, scale the enterprise profitably and build shareholder value.
